description: This file defines the class DefaultIncomingMapping, which implements a mapping function for handling incoming ExternalMessage objects. It converts messages from JSON payloads into Adaptable objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework, encapsulating the logic for parsing and transforming protocol messages.

classes.name: DefaultIncomingMapping
classes.description: A singleton class that implements the MappingFunction interface to convert ExternalMessage objects into a list of Adaptable objects, used in processing incoming messages in the Ditto connectivity service.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Converts an ExternalMessage into a list of Adaptable objects by parsing JSON payloads, handling exceptions, and returning an empty list if parsing fails.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of DefaultIncomingMapping.

methods.name: getPlainStringPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload as a plain string from an ExternalMessage, decoding byte payloads as UTF-8 if necessary.
